scope: One bounded followup-template consumer batch; not repository-wide policy closure.

confirmed_findings.finding: Unrelated PR tasks and commands could silently seed a new followup.
confirmed_findings.remediation: Remove previous-PR fallback; only preserve the explicitly addressed PR.

confirmed_findings.finding: Explicit continuation context, dissent and exact pending-node evidence could be discarded.
confirmed_findings.remediation: Preserve an explicit continuation-context section and require it at save.

confirmed_findings.finding: Save protection checked only the first preserved block.
confirmed_findings.remediation: Require every extracted preserved block before overwriting.

confirmed_findings.finding: One placeholder substring could cause real findings in the same block to be discarded.
confirmed_findings.remediation: Treat only an entire known placeholder block as placeholder.

confirmed_findings.finding: Operative universal five-pass, forced-completion and automatic continuation wording conflicted with bounded review and execution authority.
confirmed_findings.remediation: Use risk-appropriate review dimensions, honest pending work, explicit authority and no self-triggering while preserving genuine security owner/reason and execution/review controls.

confirmed_findings.finding: Caller keyword overrides could erase preserved continuation context in generated API output even though save would refuse to persist the loss.
confirmed_findings.remediation: Apply protected continuation precedence after general keywords; add exact regression. Reported by rd4-minority-review.
